lines.zh: 我走两步就蹲一下，像随时要跳。
lines.en: Every two steps I crouch, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 我沿着屋脊走，脚爪勾住瓦缝。
lines.en: I walk the rooftop, claws hooked in the tile gaps.

lines.zh: 我的腿太长，走路有点晃。
lines.en: My legs are too long, so I sway when I walk.

lines.zh: 我从村口走到广场，一路没人。
lines.en: I walk from the village gate to the square, meeting no one.

lines.zh: 我踩过晾衣绳，布掉在地上。
lines.en: I step on a clothesline and the cloth drops.

lines.zh: 我的脚尖先落地，几乎没有声音。
lines.en: My toes touch down first, almost silently.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条受伤的腿走，还是很快。
lines.en: I drag an injured leg and still move fast.

lines.zh: 我在麦田里走，穗子到我腰上。
lines.en: I walk the wheat field, stalks reaching my waist.

lines.zh: 每走一步，背上的菌斑就抖一下。
lines.en: Each step shakes the spore patch on my back.

lines.zh: 我绕着水井走了三圈，才离开。
lines.en: I circle the well three times before leaving.

lines.zh: 我走路时总在找一个更高的地方。
lines.en: As I walk I am always looking for higher ground.

lines.zh: 影子先爬上土墙，我随后才到。
lines.en: My shadow climbs the mud wall a moment before me.

lines.zh: 我蹲在屋顶上，看村里冒烟。
lines.en: I crouch on the roof and watch the village smoke.

lines.zh: 我把后腿拉直，又缩回来。
lines.en: I stretch my hind leg straight, then draw it back.

lines.zh: 我在数从屋檐到地面的高度。
lines.en: I am counting the height from eave to ground.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔爪子，把菌丝理齐。
lines.en: I lick my claws and smooth the hyphae.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的长耳朵先动。
lines.en: When the wind blows, my long ears move first.

lines.zh: 我蹲着不动，像一只等虫的鸟。
lines.en: I crouch still, like a bird waiting for a bug.

lines.zh: 我记得这里以前有集市。
lines.en: I remember there used to be a market here.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很浅，肚子一起一伏。
lines.en: My breath is shallow, my belly rising and falling.

lines.zh: 我把脖子上的破布扯正了一点。
lines.en: I straighten the torn cloth around my neck a little.

lines.zh: 高处的风比地面大，我喜欢。
lines.en: The wind is stronger up high, and I like it.

lines.zh: 我在磨脚上的硬茧，用牙。
lines.en: I wear down the callus on my foot with my teeth.

lines.zh: 远处的鸡叫了一声，我抬起头。
lines.en: A chicken calls far off, and I lift my head.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，试着感受地面。
lines.en: I press my body low and feel the ground.

lines.zh: 空闲的时候，我练习落地的姿势。
lines.en: In idle hours I practice how to land.

lines.zh: 我把脚趾抠进瓦缝，试了试。
lines.en: I dig my toes into a tile gap to test it.

lines.zh: 村里静得能听见自己的腿响。
lines.en: The village is quiet enough to hear my own legs.

lines.zh: 我抬头看烟柱，算风的方向。
lines.en: I watch the smoke column and read the wind.

lines.zh: 我在等一个落脚的时机。
lines.en: I wait for the right moment to land.

lines.zh: 我从屋檐上探下头，看着你。
lines.en: I lean down from the eave and look at you.

lines.zh: 你先抬头，我才慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: You look up first, and only then do I blink.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，估算你的肩膀有多宽。
lines.en: I tilt my head, judging the width of your shoulders.

lines.zh: 你背着包，包里有我要的东西。
lines.en: You carry a pack, and there is something in it I want.

lines.zh: 我看着你的膝盖，那里最容易折。
lines.en: I look at your knees; they bend most easily.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，我往后缩了半尺。
lines.en: You raise a torch and I shrink back half a foot.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处发黄，正对着你。
lines.en: My eyes glow yellow in the dark, fixed on you.

lines.zh: 你说话，我只听音调，不听词。
lines.en: You speak; I hear the tone, not the words.

lines.zh: 你身边有条狗，它先发现了我。
lines.en: A dog is with you, and it spots me first.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的缰绳看了很久。
lines.en: I stare a long time at the reins in your hand.

lines.zh: 你的靴底磨平了，跑起来会滑。
lines.en: Your soles are worn smooth; you will slip when you run.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶，你却先看平路。
lines.en: I am above you, yet you search the flat road.

lines.zh: 刀刃划开我的腿，我还站着。
lines.en: The blade opens my leg, and I am still standing.

lines.zh: 我落地时崴了脚，走起来一拐。
lines.en: I land badly and limp from then on.

lines.zh: 疼让我跳得更高，这也算好事。
lines.en: Pain makes me jump higher; that is something.

lines.zh: 你把我的耳朵砍掉一角。
lines.en: You slice a corner off one of my ears.

lines.zh: 背上那道口子，我够不着也舔不到。
lines.en: That gash on my back is beyond reach of my tongue.

lines.zh: 我压住腿上的口子，血还是渗。
lines.en: I press the gash on my leg; blood still seeps.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，滚了两圈才停。
lines.en: I hit the ground and roll twice before stopping.

lines.zh: 骨头没断，只是错开了。
lines.en: The bone is not broken, only shifted.

lines.zh: 你打中我的肋，我吸了口气。
lines.en: You hit my ribs, and I suck in a breath.

lines.zh: 我退到墙角，先护住后腿。
lines.en: I retreat to a corner, guarding my hind legs first.

lines.zh: 你手里那把绿宝石，我认得。
lines.en: I know those emeralds in your hand.

lines.zh: 面包的味道让我想起赶集的日子。
lines.en: The smell of bread recalls market days.

lines.zh: 你把货袋放下，我就从屋顶下来。
lines.en: Set the trade sack down and I come off the roof.

lines.zh: 我以前也背过这样的包。
lines.en: I used to carry a pack like that one.

lines.zh: 那枚铜钱一晃，我的耳朵就竖了。
lines.en: A copper coin flashes, and my ears prick up.

lines.zh: 我不动手，只凑近闻闻那袋货。
lines.en: I will not grab it; I only lean in to sniff your sack.

lines.zh: 你往包里塞东西，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I see clearly what you tuck into that bag.

lines.zh: 甜浆果的味，比肉更让我动心。
lines.en: Sweet berries tempt me more than meat.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，把手摊开给你看。
lines.en: I crouch and turn my empty palms up to you.

lines.zh: 换一样东西吧，我没什么能给的。
lines.en: Let us trade; I have nothing left to give.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的背，两个人一起歪了。
lines.en: I hit your back and we both stagger.

lines.zh: 我的身子轻，撞你像扔来一个麻袋。
lines.en: I am light; hitting you is like a thrown sack.

lines.zh: 你扶住我，我的手先摸到你的腰带。
lines.en: You catch me, and my hand finds your belt first.

lines.zh: 落地时我踩到你的脚，抱歉。
lines.en: I land on your foot; my apologies.

lines.zh: 我们撞开一扇木门，门板飞了。
lines.en: We burst a wooden door, and the plank flies.

lines.zh: 我一撞就弹开，腿先着地。
lines.en: I bounce off the impact, legs landing first.

lines.zh: 你比我重，可我先站稳。
lines.en: You are heavier, but I find my footing first.

lines.zh: 我的肩骨硌人，你该让一让。
lines.en: My shoulder bone is sharp; you should step aside.

lines.zh: 撞完之后，我顺手抓了你的袖子。
lines.en: After the bump I catch your sleeve.

lines.zh: 别在窄巷里堵我，我只会跳过去。
lines.en: Do not block me in an alley; I will just jump over.

lines.zh: 我们在屋脊两头蹲着，谁也没过去。
lines.en: We crouch at both ends of the ridge, neither approaching.

lines.zh: 它跳过来，我往旁边让了半步。
lines.en: It leaps over, and I give half a step.

lines.zh: 两只激跃者在一起，落地声叠成一声。
lines.en: Two leapers land as a single sound.

lines.zh: 我替它梳背上的菌斑，它替我梳腿。
lines.en: I groom its back patch; it grooms my legs.

lines.zh: 我们比谁跳得更远，输的让食。
lines.en: We race our jumps, and the loser yields the food.

lines.zh: 它叫得很轻，只有我听得到。
lines.en: Its call is faint; only I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一个草垛里过夜。
lines.en: We share one haystack through the night.

lines.zh: 同类的气味很淡，像雨后的土。
lines.en: The scent of kin is faint, like earth after rain.

lines.zh: 它跳上我背，我没有甩开。
lines.en: It lands on my back, and I do not throw it off.

lines.zh: 我们并排蹲着，一起看村口的路。
lines.en: We crouch side by side, watching the village road.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块瓦片，掂了掂。
lines.en: I pick up a roof tile and weigh it.

lines.zh: 地上那枚绿宝石，我攥了很久。
lines.en: I hold the emerald from the ground a long while.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的苹果塞进嘴里。
lines.en: I stuff the fallen apple into my mouth.

lines.zh: 拾取时我蹲得很低，怕扯到腿。
lines.en: I crouch low to pick things up, wary of my leg.

lines.zh: 我用脚把东西勾过来，省得弯腰。
lines.en: I hook things over with my foot instead of bending.

lines.zh: 那根绳子我收起来，以后有用。
lines.en: I keep that rope; it may be useful later.

lines.zh: 我捡起一只破鞋，闻了闻。
lines.en: I pick up a worn shoe and sniff it.

lines.zh: 你的箭我拾了一支，插在腰上。
lines.en: I pick up one of your arrows and tuck it at my waist.

lines.zh: 我把散落的麦粒一颗颗捡净。
lines.en: I pick up every scattered grain of wheat.

lines.zh: 手心的东西太满，掉了两颗。
lines.en: My hands are too full, and two pieces drop.

lines.zh: 你从我下面的路走过，我记住了。
lines.en: You pass on the road below, and I mark you.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵转向你，先于眼睛。
lines.en: My ears turn toward you before my eyes do.

lines.zh: 你踩断一根树枝，我就锁定了。
lines.en: You snap a twig, and the target is set.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，后腿贴住瓦面。
lines.en: I flatten down, hind legs gripping the tiles.

lines.zh: 你还在找路，我已经找好落点。
lines.en: You still seek a path; I have chosen my landing.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道顺风过来，很新。
lines.en: Your scent comes on the wind, very fresh.

lines.zh: 你回头了，那说明你也听见我了。
lines.en: You look back, so you heard me too.

lines.zh: 我算好了三步的距离，够了。
lines.en: I have measured three paces; that is enough.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，反而让我更想试。
lines.en: That shield of yours only makes me want to try.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，正好没有退路。
lines.en: You back to the wall, and there is no way left.

lines.zh: 我在屋顶上跟着你，从这头到那头。
lines.en: I follow along the roofs, end to end.

lines.zh: 你跑进巷子，我从上面越过墙。
lines.en: You run into the alley; I cross the wall above.

lines.zh: 每过一个路口，我就更近一点。
lines.en: At every crossing I get a little closer.

lines.zh: 你停下喘气，我也停下等你。
lines.en: You stop to breathe; I stop and wait.

lines.zh: 我踩落一片瓦，你抬头看了。
lines.en: I kick a tile loose, and you look up.

lines.zh: 我不走直线，我走最短的落点。
lines.en: I do not go straight; I take the shortest landings.

lines.zh: 你拐进树林，树冠正好连成路。
lines.en: You enter the woods, and the canopy becomes my road.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你前面的地上跳。
lines.en: My shadow jumps along the ground ahead of you.

lines.zh: 你听声辨位，可我不落地。
lines.en: You track me by sound, but I do not touch down.

lines.zh: 距离只剩一跳，我数到三。
lines.en: One jump remains; I count to three.

lines.zh: 我从天而降，两只脚先踹到你。
lines.en: I drop from above, both feet striking first.

lines.zh: 落地的一瞬，我的爪已经切进去。
lines.en: The instant I land, my claws are already in.

lines.zh: 我扑你的肩，借力再弹开。
lines.en: I pounce on your shoulder and spring away again.

lines.zh: 你举刀，我从刀下钻过去咬。
lines.en: You raise your blade; I duck under and bite.

lines.zh: 这一下用了我半条腿的力气。
lines.en: That blow cost me half the strength in my leg.

lines.zh: 我撕开你的背包带，东西撒了。
lines.en: I tear your pack strap and the contents spill.

lines.zh: 我的爪子陷进你的护甲，拔出来费劲。
lines.en: My claws sink into your armor and pull out hard.

lines.zh: 你架住我的第一爪，第二爪从腰侧来。
lines.en: You catch my first claw; my second comes at your hip.

lines.zh: 我把你按倒，膝盖顶住你胸口。
lines.en: I pin you down, knee on your chest.

lines.zh: 一击不中，我就退到三步外重来。
lines.en: If I miss, I retreat three paces and try again.

lines.zh: 我从一个村民的床上坐起来。
lines.en: I sit up in a villager's bed.

lines.zh: 菌丝先长好腿，我才学会站。
lines.en: Hyphae finished my legs before I learned to stand.

lines.zh: 我醒来时，屋里的灯还亮着。
lines.en: When I wake, the lamp in the house is still lit.

lines.zh: 我原来是个赶商人，货还在门口。
lines.en: I was a trader once; my goods are still at the door.

lines.zh: 我从草垛里挣出来，身上全是秆。
lines.en: I work my way out of a haystack, covered in stalks.

lines.zh: 我第一次跳，撞塌了半面墙。
lines.en: My first jump knocked down half a wall.

lines.zh: 村庄空着，我成了这里的东西。
lines.en: The village is empty, and I became its creature.

lines.zh: 我记得自己的名字，只有一个音节。
lines.en: I remember my name; it is one syllable.

lines.zh: 我在钟楼里成形，钟早就哑了。
lines.en: I take shape in the bell tower; the bell is long mute.

lines.zh: 我从井口爬出，浑身是水。
lines.en: I climb out of the well, soaked through.

lines.zh: 菌染的村民倒下了，我站起来。
lines.en: An infected villager fell, and I rose.

lines.zh: 我的第一声叫，把鸟惊飞了。
lines.en: My first call scattered the birds.

lines.zh: 火舔到我的腿毛，焦味冲鼻。
lines.en: Fire licks my leg fur, and the stink fills my nose.

lines.zh: 十三格内我摔不坏，可这一下有点疼。
lines.en: Inside thirteen blocks I land fine, though this one hurts.

lines.zh: 我掉进井水，扑腾着找边。
lines.en: I fall into the well water, thrashing for the wall.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀上屋脊，又摔下来。
lines.en: The blast throws me onto the roof, then down.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的侧腹，毛被削掉一条。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my flank and shaves a stripe of fur.

lines.zh: 药水味钻进鼻子，我跳不动了。
lines.en: The potion smell fills my nose and I cannot jump.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，我连菌斑都想啃。
lines.en: When hungry, I would even chew my own spore patch.

lines.zh: 雷劈在屋脊上，我整只跳了起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the ridge and I leap straight up.

lines.zh: 我踩空了，脚下的村子不见了。
lines.en: I step into nothing; the village below is gone.
